# Story 16.1: Red-phase unit tests for tax_free_income settings round-trip

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase unit tests asserting `tax_free_income` is persisted and returned by the settings route,
So that Story 16.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it fixes the schema/handler field-name mismatch (P0 item #3 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A spec asserts that a settings write including `tax_free_income` persists the value — i.e., after a POST with `tax_free_income` set, the stored/returned settings contain the same `tax_free_income` value (not dropped to undefined).
2. A spec asserts that a subsequent read of settings returns the same `tax_free_income` value that was written (round-trip integrity).
3. All assertions in AC #1–#2 are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so the server Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 16.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. Existing passing tests remain unskipped and green.
4. The spec file(s) run green under `nx test server` immediately after this story (new red-phase tests skipped), and Story 16.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against current code, then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a write-persists assertion for `tax_free_income`.
  - [ ] 1.1 In a spec under `apps/server/src/app/routes/settings/`, POST a settings payload including `tax_free_income` and assert the value is persisted (not dropped to undefined).
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add a read round-trip assertion.
  - [ ] 2.1 After the write, GET/read the settings and assert the returned `tax_free_income` equals the written value.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3, #4): Mark red-phase assertions `.skip()` and confirm green.
  - [ ] 3.1 Apply `it.skip` to every assertion added in Tasks 1–2 — they are red until Story 16.2 aligns the field names. Leave all pre-existing tests unskipped.
  - [ ] 3.2 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase tests skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** at `apps/server/src/app/routes/settings/index.ts:168,192` the body schema declares `tax_free_income` but the handler destructures `taxFreeIncome`, so the tax-free income group is always silently dropped (undefined) on every POST — a data-loss bug. This is P0 item #3 from Aspect 9.
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 16.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while the mismatch still exists; Story 16.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then aligns until green.
- **Do NOT modify production code in this story** — unit-test scaffold only. The field-name alignment belongs to Story 16.2.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create/modify: a spec under `apps/server/src/app/routes/settings/` (add skipped write-persists + read round-trip assertions for `tax_free_income`).
- No changes to production `.ts` in this story.
